name: dokploy
description: Self-hosted Dokploy PaaS: deploying applications through Nixpacks, Railpack, Dockerfile, Buildpack, and static builds with domains, certificates, and vault-backed environment variables; operating the host — installation, remote and dedicated build servers, cluster, panel and database backups with tested restores, and symptom-first troubleshooting; scripting the full CLI and API surface, which the published documentation covers only in part; hardening the panel, Traefik, and secrets against a 25-control checklist mapped to SOC 2 and ISO 27001; configuring enterprise SSO, SCIM, custom roles, and audit logs; and a guard against irreversible project, database, and volume removal.
